Figure 1:Different generations, familiar choices.Five baseline outputs per task
.Top:GPT-5.5 webpages generated from the same simple prompt and a given website content.Middle:GPT Image 2 outputs for“A cat is curled up next to a light teddy bear.”Bottom:Independent GPT-6 Astra agent runs asked to build a functional 3D folding chair. See Figures4,5, and6for comparison with MSR, with protocols and results in Sections3.3,3.4, and3.5.
Figure 4:Webpages generated by GPT-5.5 with a fixed prompt (top) and additionally MSR (bottom).

Figure 5:Images generated by GPT Image 2 using the prompt“A cat is curled up next to a light teddy bear.”(Row 1)Original prompt only.(Row 2)Independent rewrite with GPT-5.6 Sol.(Row 3)MSR–Resolved, using GPT-5.6 Sol for semantic resolution.
Figure 6:3D folding chairs generated with GPT-6 Astra.
Figure 7:(Top)Example of a report generated by GPT-6 Astra for a generated folding chair.(Bottom)Illustration of the folding mechanism, originally provided as a video.

Figure 8:From sampled attributes to an articulated chair: open, intermediate, and folded states of the same generated Blender model. The programmed sequence includes a lift and tilt during folding; the folded pose is held rather than claimed to stand unsupported. These renders demonstrate modeled folding motion, not physically verified performance.

Figure 9:Webpages generated by GPT-5.5 using the prompt“Create a training hub page using the grounding file for the manufacturing onboarding program. Use orange and yellow as the main colors – I want it to feel energetic and welcoming. Include all content and images from the grounding doc.”(Left)Original prompt only.(Middle)Mine–Sample–Renderusing the Websight schema(Right)Mine–Sample–Renderusing the Design2Code schema.

Figure 10:Webpages generated by Kimi K2.6 using the prompt“Create a recap page for the Axium annual hackathon using the grounding doc, green color scheme.”(Left)Original prompt only.(Middle)Mine–Sample–Renderusing the Websight schema(Right)Mine–Sample–Renderusing the Design2Code schema.
